captures.description: THE LAB, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Electronic Literature Lab (ELL) is a media archaeology research facility founded in 2011 and directed by Dr. Dene Grigar at Washington State University Vancouver.' Mission (archive, restore, conserve and present 'born-digital art, literature, and video games from 1977 to the present'); collection ('over 80 vintage Macintosh computers and PCs', 'a library of thousands of digital literary works and retro video games'); archival center for the ELO and manager of The NEXT; four rooms (the Marjorie C. Luesebrink Reading Room, the Archives Room, the Restoration Room, the Studio); address, phone, electronicliteraturelab.org. Four cards: electronicliteraturelab.org, Washington State University, Wikipedia, Instagram.
